metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Geometric Sans-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a centered male subject with modern, geometric sans-serif typography positioned in the upper corners.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white headshot

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, black-and-white close-up portrait of a man with messy hair, looking directly at the camera. The lighting is dramatic, creating deep shadows and bright highlights. The typography is a clean, geometric sans-serif with unique 'A' and 'R' constructions, placed symmetrically in the top left and right corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical typography flanking a centered subject
High contrast between the dark background and the subject's face
Text alignment with the top edge of the frame
Direct eye contact creating a focal point in the center
coreInvariants: Geometric sans-serif typography with open-counter 'A' and 'R'

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, large-scale headshot filling the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves upward to the corner typography, then down to the subject's clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background surrounding the head and shoulders, providing high contrast for the white text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and facial highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and hair detail
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from pure black to pure white.

letterConstructionRules: Modified 'A' with a missing crossbar or unique diagonal join
Modified 'R' with a detached or stylized leg
characterSpecificRedesigns: A: Stylized as a chevron or with a high, thin crossbar
R: Open counter with a straight diagonal leg starting from the stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both name and title to maintain minimalist symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base geometric skeleton and clean monolinear strokes.
Captures the 90s geometric aesthetic and high x-height.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, black and white close-up portrait of a man with messy hair against a solid black background, ensuring the top corners remain empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners in solid white, using wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text positioned in the top corners?
Does the 'A' have a unique geometric construction?
Is the subject centered and looking at the camera?

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black levels in the background
Ensure no color artifacts are present
Confirm the 'A' and 'R' match the geometric style
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Geometric Corner Typography + High Contrast Lighting
